title: VErsion Range Specifier (VERS) Type Definition
description: Schema to define the structure of a VErsion Range Specifier (VERS) type.

$schema.title: JSON schema
$schema.description: URL of the JSON schema for VERS type definition.

$id.title: VERS type definition id
$id.description: The unique identifier URI for this VERS type definition.

type.title: VERS type
type.description: The type string for this VERS type.

type_name.title: Type name
type_name.description: The name of this VERS type.

description.title: Description
description.description: The description of this VERS type.
examples: Apache Maven dependency version requirement notation as used in a Maven POM.
npm dependencies version range notation as used in a package.json.

vers_examples.title: VERS examples
vers_examples.description: Examples of valid, canonical VERS ranges for this VERS type.

native_syntax_description.title: Native Syntax Description
native_syntax_description.description: Optional description of the native syntax or notation for the version range described by this VERS type.
examples: npm dependencies are specified in an object mapping a package name to a version range, a string which has one or more space-separated descriptors.

native_syntax_elements.title: Native Version Range Syntax Elements
native_syntax_elements.description: Optional array of descriptions for syntax elements of the native version range described by this VERS type.
examples: The superior character means a version must be bigger than the version in that contraint. Example: > 2.0.0
Each range constraint is separated by a space.
The tilde character means that a version should be at least equal to the version in that contraint. Example: ~2.0.0
The equal character means that a version should be equal to the version in that contraint. Example: =2.0.0-ALPHA2
The range boundaries are decribed using mathematical notation with [] and ().
Each range constraint is separated by a comma, and spaces are not significant.

native_range_examples.title: Native Version Range Examples
native_range_examples.description: Optional examples of valid, native version ranges for this VERS type.

native_version_examples.title: Native Version Examples
native_version_examples.description: Optional examples of valid, native versions for this VERS type.

version_comparison_procedure.title: Version Comparison Procedure
version_comparison_procedure.description: Optional procedure describing how to compare two versions for this VERS type.
examples: Split the version string on punctuations, and letters, yield components. Compare each component strings from left to right using their lexicographic order.

reference_urls.title: Reference URLs
reference_urls.description: Optional list of informational reference URLs about this VERS type.
